checks.result: The exact implementation commit passed all 12 foundation commands, including repository, runtime, architecture, agent protocol, generated views, fixture corpus, ADR, CI, quality, packaging, 78 foundation tests, and backlog validation.

The immutable corpus passed exact inventory, schema, license, provenance, SHA-256, byte-length, structural, semantic feature, PDF xref, and intentional rejection validation for 11 files and 20 features.
Five focused tests passed for the canonical corpus and material tamper, unlicensed/undocumented file, malformed-case, and invalid PDF xref boundaries.
The authoritative ledger validated with 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.

evidence: The repository-authored corpus contains no third-party scholarly content; LICENSE.txt, README.md, the schema, the global manifest provenance, and every item record the CC0-1.0 dedication and synthetic origin.

Eleven exact-inventory fixtures cover complete, partial, variant, duplicate-DOI, and Unicode metadata; JSON, RIS, BibTeX, XML, plain text, and PDF; tables, citations, and bibliography; plus deliberately malformed JSON, XML, and PDF.

The manifest declares offline and deterministic operation and pins every file by SHA-256 and byte length. The validator performs no network access and fails closed on missing, extra, redirected, altered, structurally invalid, or semantically incomplete content.

Five focused mutation tests validate the expected corpus and detect content tampering, missing license metadata, undocumented files, a malformed fixture that no longer fails, and an accepted PDF with inconsistent cross-reference offsets.
The full foundation suite increased to 78 tests and passes with the corpus validator as a mandatory profile command.
verification-profiles.json makes fixture validation mandatory in foundation; quality-scope.json governs the validator and tests; .gitattributes treats PDF fixtures as binary.

The automation, tool, fixture, and foundation-test documentation explains licensing, provenance, coverage, offline validation, and the safe synthetic-only update procedure. No application or later-capability implementation scope changed.

reviewerDisposition.note: An independent reviewer must probe redistribution provenance, inventory/hash enforcement, semantic edge-case coverage, malformed-input behavior, path confinement, PDF integrity, and foundation integration before approval.
